reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'France' THEN i.total ELSE 0 END) AS france_revenue, SUM(i.total) AS all_invoice_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'France' THEN i.total ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(i.total), 0) AS share_fraction FROM public.invoice AS i JOIN public.customer AS c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
